name: TileTrees
definition: A data structure for texture mapping surfaces that stores square texture tiles in the leaves of an octree surrounding the surface. At rendering time, the surface is projected onto the tiles, and color is retrieved by a 2D texture fetch into a tile map. It avoids global planar parameterizations, supports implicit surfaces, and allows adaptive resolution.
summary: TileTrees map surfaces to 2D texture tiles within an octree, avoiding global parameterizations and reducing data overhead compared to volume approaches.
